test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the following question. The umbers in different sections indicate the number of persons in a small village relying on different sources of energy for their daily needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/184c2fe5ae42890788c6880c272fefa435f77cf5cfe71093a262955b7edef7c7.png] 

How many people rely on both Solar energy and Coal energy?
solution:
• The shaded part represents both Solar energy and Coal energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97fa2a2e2a421e76dece09bfbf841e171986893d0d27070047d3b10a46c365de.png] 

 
• The number of people who rely on both Solar energy and Coal energy = 28 + 12 = 40

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (3)**.
